## Progress

- `FibreCorollaries.lean`: added arbitrary-field finite underlying preimages for isogenies (`c756abab5d`).
- `DimensionCorollaries.lean`: added cotangent-rank and regular-stalk transport along section translations (`19eaa3c0b4`).
- `MilneLib.lean`: exports the new module.
- Hgraph/cache synchronized: 265 blueprint records, 304 parsed Lean declarations, 245 edges; published cache 262 nodes and 197 edges.
- LSP, focused `lean_verify`, `lake build MilneLib` (3171 jobs), the correctly scoped Horizon check, and final `lake env lean MilneLib.lean` all pass. Only standard axioms appear; no `sorry`, `admit`, or project axioms were added.
- The report, task comment, and running task state were captured in shared commit `fc82719bbb`. That commit also contains another writer’s `FiniteTypeExtras` wrapper; I did not duplicate or alter it.

## Issues

- The frozen four-way isogeny characterization remains open on projectivity/global dimension and intrinsic homomorphism flatness.
- Auxiliary declarations remain intentionally unlinked. Existing graph-cycle and three stale-record warnings remain.
- An initial Horizon check used the wrong working directory and failed module resolution; the corrected invocation passed. A full workspace build was not run.
- Pre-existing Milne edits in `LocalProperties.lean` and `Tensor.lean`, plus unrelated cross-project worktree/control-plane changes, remain untouched and uncommitted.

## Why I stopped

The objective is partly advanced, not complete. `fs-milne` remains `running` as required for this standing task.

## Next

Prioritize the proper abelian-variety projectivity/global-dimension bridge, then unconditional homomorphism flatness and the generic coherent-stalk/cotangent bridge.
